items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: Shared spring presets that respect reduced motion.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: Controlled or uncontrolled state with a single API.

items.name: fluid-highlight
items.title: Fluid Highlight
items.description: One hover highlight per group that glides between items.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with a spring press.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a gliding hover highlight and a spring active indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch whose thumb stretches on press and springs across.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu that springs open from its trigger, with one highlight gliding between items.

items.name: text-units
items.title: Text Units
items.description: Splits text into words or graphemes for animation.

items.name: text-effects
items.title: Text Effects
items.description: Shared entrance frames for kinematic text components.

items.name: use-smooth-text
items.title: useSmoothText
items.description: Releases streamed text at a steady, self-correcting rate.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Renders streamed model output, smoothing token bursts and easing each new word into place.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Staggers a fixed string into view by word or letter.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A band of light that sweeps across text for thinking states.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Three dots rising and falling in a soft wave.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window that springs in from slightly smaller and out of focus, then springs back out the same way, so quick open and close never jumps.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog that needs an explicit answer, and nudges in place when you click outside it instead of closing.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that springs in from any edge of the screen and springs back out the same way, without ever showing a gap at the edge.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A draggable panel built on vaul that follows your finger and flings closed, with a handle that stretches while you drag.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command menu built on cmdk, where one highlight glides between results for arrow keys and hover alike, and the list springs to its new height as you type.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label for form controls that dims with its disabled control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field whose border and focus ring ease in on hover and focus instead of snapping.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content and eases its focus ring in.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose check mark draws itself in with a snappy spring and retracts when unchecked.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive options whose inner dot springs in on the chosen item and out of the last one.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range input whose thumb swells while you drag it, with the filled range tracking it exactly.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that presses in with a snappy spring, for on/off tools like bold or bookmark.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggles where, in single mode, one pill glides to the pressed item and a hover highlight follows the pointer.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code field where the focus ring glides between slots and each typed character pops in.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of collapsible sections whose content springs open to its natural height while the chevron turns.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single region that shows and hides, with its height springing open and closed.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered surface for grouping related content and actions, with header, action, content and footer slots.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, counts or metadata, in four variants.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user image with an initials fallback that crossfades into the photo once it loads.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline callout for important messages, with an optional icon, title and description.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin horizontal or vertical rule that divides content.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder block for loading content, with a soft shimmer that sweeps across it.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A horizontal bar showing how far a task has got, with the fill springing to each new value.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with slim custom scrollbars that fade in while you hover or scroll.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A small key cap for showing keyboard shortcuts and key combinations.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A site navigation bar whose panel springs to the size of each section and slides in from the direction you moved.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links to the current page, with one highlight gliding between links as you hover.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links for long result sets, with a pill that glides to the current page.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Stacked toast notifications themed with Kinematic tokens, where icons pop in as each toast settles.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A semantic data table where one highlight glides between body rows as you hover.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to its trigger that springs out from the trigger's side and settles back the same way.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that pops from its trigger and skips the delay when you move to the next one.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that opens on hover intent and springs out from the side of its link.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A form control for picking one value from a list, where the panel springs from the trigger and the highlight rests on the current choice.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that springs open from the pointer, with one highlight gliding between items and sub-menus.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop-style row of menus where one highlight slides between triggers and rests on the open one, and each menu springs from its trigger.
